concept.title: Identifying reusable content
concept.shortdesc: During content development, identify content that appears in multiple places:

conbody.p:
During content development, identify content that appears in multiple places:
Warning and caution messages
Legal disclaimers
Common procedures (login, logout, save)
Product descriptions
Support contact information
Standard notes and tips
When the same content appears in two or more locations, extract it into a reusable file.
